notes.title: Major performance update
notes.notes:
A while ago, we started hearing from our players that the game was crashing unexpectedly and therefore caused bad user experience. 

As user experience and enjoyment are our top priorities, we dove deep into the code and identified the source of the issue. 

We are now in the last stage of testing and will release this major update before the end of November. 

Thank you for playing Stanislav.
